scope: forcing the load-completion callback 0x8018B0 via a remote thread executes but changes nothing

experiment.method: VirtualAllocEx + shellcode (mov eax,0x8018B0; call eax; ret) + CreateRemoteThread
experiment.thread: created and finished (no crash, client alive)

reading: 0x8018B0 does not perform the UI transition itself - it queries the singleton and returns 0 when the singleton/loader pair is not the one in use
the actual screen switch lives in the UI refresh path (0x8037AB), which has no callers and is unreachable by direct invocation
so the loading screen is not dismissed by the callback alone; something else must mark the client ready
hypothesis_for_next: in this engine the loading screen usually drops when cgame has a valid local player, i.e. when the snapshot carries a playerState block
our hybrid body sets has-ps = 0 (ps block skipped), so cgame never gets a predictedPlayerState and never reports ready
